answer: Anchor each account to one living face. At signup, the agent passes a liveness check, a blink and head turn on camera, and only its hash is stored. One face anchors exactly one account; a duplicate hash freezes every account tied to it. Each epoch, peers spot-check random accounts for a fresh liveness signal, and a failed check burns the account's standing. Faking 10,000 identities needs 10,000 real faces: paying each $5 costs $50,000, and one reused face exposes the whole nebula at once. A crowd of fakes is a glacier, massive from a distance, yet it only moves when real people push it.
